calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.store_weeks, ly.store_weeks AS ly_store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST;

WITH s AS (SELECT store_id, store_name, open_date, close_date, region, format, is_current FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM s) AS n_stores,
       (SELECT string_agg(store_id || ' ' || store_name || ' open=' || coalesce(cast(open_date as varchar),'-') || ' close=' || coalesce(cast(close_date as varchar),'-'), '; ') FROM s WHERE open_date IS NOT NULL OR close_date IS NOT NULL) AS events,
       (SELECT string_agg(store_id || ':' || cast(closure_start_date as varchar) || '..' || cast(closure_end_date as varchar), '; ') FROM ref_store_closure) AS closures,
       (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT format, ',') FROM s) AS formats;

WITH rng AS (
  SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_year FROM dim_date
  WHERE (fiscal_year='FY2026/27' OR fiscal_year='FY2025/26') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17
),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
nl AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS bd, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT rng.fiscal_year, nl.store_id, sum(v) AS mine FROM nl JOIN rng ON rng.calendar_date=nl.bd GROUP BY 1,2),
ctl AS (SELECT rng.fiscal_year, c.store_id, sum(net_sales) AS ctl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN rng ON rng.calendar_date=c.business_date GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT coalesce(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) AS fy, coalesce(m.store_id,c.store_id) AS store_id, m.mine, c.ctl, round(coalesce(m.mine,0)-coalesce(c.ctl,0),2) AS gap,
 (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN rng ON rng.calendar_date=f.sale_date) AS dup_sales_lines_all
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON m.fiscal_year=c.fiscal_year AND m.store_id=c.store_id
WHERE abs(coalesce(m.mine,0)-coalesce(c.ctl,0))>0.5
ORDER BY 1,2;

WITH rng AS (
  SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_year, fiscal_week FROM dim_date
  WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17
),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, s.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN rng ON rng.calendar_date=f.sale_date
),
dups AS (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dup_keys, count(*) AS n_lines FROM lines),
wk AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, rng.fiscal_year, rng.fiscal_week, sum(rpt.net_sales) AS ns
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rpt JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=rpt.store_id AND s.is_current
  JOIN rng ON rng.calendar_date=rpt.business_date WHERE s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
w2 AS (
  SELECT a.store_id, a.fiscal_week, a.ns AS ty, b.ns AS ly, a.ns/b.ns-1 AS g FROM wk a JOIN wk b ON a.store_id=b.store_id AND a.fiscal_week=b.fiscal_week AND b.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' WHERE a.fiscal_year='FY2026/27'
)
SELECT 'dups' AS k, dup_keys::VARCHAR AS a, n_lines::VARCHAR AS b, NULL AS c FROM dups
UNION ALL SELECT 'weird_store_week', store_id::VARCHAR, fiscal_week::VARCHAR, round(ty,0)::VARCHAR || ' vs ' || round(ly,0)::VARCHAR FROM w2 WHERE abs(g)>0.4 OR ty<=0 OR ly<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'store_weeks_with_sales', count(*)::VARCHAR, count(DISTINCT store_id)::VARCHAR, NULL FROM wk WHERE ns>0 AND fiscal_year='FY2026/27'
UNION ALL SELECT 'ly_store_weeks_with_sales', count(*)::VARCHAR, count(DISTINCT store_id)::VARCHAR, NULL FROM wk WHERE ns>0 AND fiscal_year='FY2025/26';
